html:
We are proud to announce that our innovative Virtual Patient Simulation System has won the Silver Award at the prestigious Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions. This recognition is a testament to our team’s dedication to advancing healthcare technology and enhancing medical education. Our system provides a groundbreaking approach to medical training, allowing healthcare professionals to simulate a variety of clinical scenarios with a virtual patient. This achievement marks a significant milestone in our journey to revolutionize medical simulations.

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of our partners and supporters who have been part of this incredible journey. Special gratitude goes to Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) and all our collaborators who have helped us bring this vision to life.
